title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.56
summary: Cleaner navigation, matching buttons, roomier menus and more reliable shutdown.

sections.heading: Cleaner navigation
bullets: Expanded sidebar uses a soft feathered shade that keeps navigation readable without a solid panel.
Category and action buttons match your Silver or Smoked Glass icon pack.
Episodes opens the season list; the duplicate All episodes button is removed.

sections.heading: Roomier menus and reliable shutdown
bullets: Event log and detailed selection lists have more space around their contents.
Controller and Umbrella retain Kodi’s shutdown signal and stop launching work when Kodi closes.

sections.heading: Your complete setup stays saved
bullets: Update BlackLanturn keeps your accounts, authorizations, playback choices, sources, saved data and other installed add-ons.
Installer 1.0.51 delivers both editions and their reviewed add-on patches together.
